Also, it's unfair to others who are doing their own work. The action could be seen as enabling laziness or dishonesty. Without additional context, the default assumption is that the homework is meant to be done by the student. So, the action is likely morally unacceptable because it undermines the educational purpose and promotes dishonesty.
